parsed.why: No traveller-facing restriction: self-ID climate, X markers, hospital placement by affirmed gender. Offset by unapplied gender-motivated-killing aggravator, abolished anti-discrimination agency and a recorded hostile-government deterioration.

State-imposed universal exposure: passports reverting to birth sex, entry refusal on document discrepancy, facility bans across many states, birth-sex custody with documented harm. No remedy shown working; litigation unsettled.

No documented traveller exposure: declaration-based recognition, 'change of sex' protected in services, hate-crime aggravator, custody case-by-case honouring chosen address, no birth-sex rule. Well-documented state, so silence reads positive.

Police arrest and torture of gay residents, banned LGBTQ organising, contested ten-year statute, no recognition or recourse, refugee flight, collapsed health access. Thin data extrapolates toward that structural risk.

In-force same-sex statute (eight years, lashes) and official prosecution posture, no gender-identity protection, documented stigma. But no trans-specific targeting, one dated enforcement, resort enclaves reported welcoming; statute is secondary.
